# pump.fun under the instrument: sixteen days, every number


*Generated by `scripts/report_pumpfun.py` on 2026-10-26 from the files in this repository. Window: 2026-10-05 00:00 → 2026-10-21 00:00 UTC, 16 UTC days, one run of the lab tool per day on the collector's hourly files (`scripts/lab/solana-courbes.mjs`, unchanged across the window). Family measured: pump.fun tokens quoted in SOL (`pf|SOL`); the "mayhem" variant, other quote tokens and Raydium LaunchLab are read for control and reported separately. All P&L figures are on bonding-curve flows, curve fees included; "strict" counts unsold tokens at zero, "valued" prices them at the last curve price. Every table can be regenerated with `make report`.*

## 1. Coverage, integrity and verification of the curve formula


Each day the tool reads the hourly files of the collector (24 files plus the first hour of the next day to close positions), checks that no minute is missing, and verifies every swap against the bonding-curve formula (a buy must move the price up, a sell down; the reconstructed price must match the on-chain state). The canary compares the number of pump.fun program transactions received with the number expected from the chain.

## 2. Launches, graduations and the second buyer


A token "graduates" when its curve fills and it moves to PumpSwap. "No trade" = tokens that never saw a swap. "Second buyer" = share of tokens with at least one buy within 60 s from an address outside the creator's cluster (strict: the buyer is not a known bundle or sniper pattern; ≥ 0.01 / 0.05 SOL: with a minimum size). `echangesMed` = median number of swaps per token.

## 13. What the instrument does not see


- Sales after graduation on PumpSwap are invisible to the curve reader: P&L on graduated tokens and creators' P&L are lower bounds.
- The strict rule counts unsold tokens at zero; the valued variant and the never-sold exclusion are in section 4.
- Bots, snipers and wash trades are not filtered out of "the crowd"; if anything they make its median less negative.
- Solana transaction, priority and trading-bot fees are not deducted: the crowd's true P&L is worse than shown.
- An address is not a person; co-signing addresses are not merged (merging was tested on the food-chain run and changed nothing).
- Sixteen days are one market regime (post-peak October 2026); consecutive days are not independent, so the day-level sign tests are indicative.
- The graduation rate measured here (2.5 %) is above the 0.6–1.0 % reported in the literature for 2024–2025: a mania month, and a different perimeter (tokens quoted in SOL only).
